== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1240_79</code>, Virtual Block 4 slip 78), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-78-Corellian_Engineering_Corporation.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-corellianengineeringcorporation-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (V)]]; the Master List (2013) prints the original too.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p869160 by darkjediknight11, 4 March 2014 (Competitive Balance Team errata): https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p869160. Icons the post writes out are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table if [Virtual Block 4] Watch Your Step on table. X = number of your spaceport sites controlled by your Corellians. While you control Corellia, your total battle destiny is +X, and once per turn, if you are about to lose Force (except from your card), may reduce loss by X. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1240_79</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Lore quotes set as printed (‘Big Three’, ‘stock’). Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB4-78-Corellian_Engineering_Corporation-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B38 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
